headline: Ghani Dairies Installs 600 kW Solar System to Cut Energy Costs and PSX Reliance
summary: Ghani Dairies announced the successful installation of a 600 kW solar energy system at its dairy farm under its Solar Expansion Project to reduce conventional energy costs.
why: Industrial adoption of renewable energy installations helps listed manufacturers lower operating expenses and mitigate fossil fuel price volatility.

impacts.name: Ghani Dairies Limited
impacts.why: Reducing energy operating costs improves corporate profit margins over the long term.
